purpose: Deterministic arbitrage comparison fixture for the shipped US3 same-family visualization surface.

origin.author: OpenAI Codex
origin.construction: Manually authored from the shared current-library direct-trace and controller-driven arbitrage cases, then checked against the focused visualization unit and integration comparison suites.
origin.refresh_policy: Refresh only when the canonical arbitrage comparison field names, supported series ordering, or deterministic unsupported-case wording intentionally change.

unsupported_cases.cross_family: Reject BatteryLoadPVScenario requests as out of scope for the MVP instead of attempting reduced cross-family comparison.
unsupported_cases.missing_series: Reject requests when a canonical same-family series such as requested_power_kw is absent from one run.
unsupported_cases.incompatible_lengths: Reject requests when a canonical same-family series has incompatible step counts.

provenance_notes: Keep this fixture synthetic, small, and reviewable.
The supported same-family comparison expectations match the focused arbitrage direct-trace versus controller-driven comparison suite.
This fixture also records the required deterministic unsupported comparison categories for cross-family, missing-series, and incompatible-length requests.
